normalized_cause: Keep 12H daytime shifts out of the 24H predicate
evidence_summary: For a standard `ShiftWindow(7, 19)`, the new range condition is true, and `classify_shift` checks this predicate before `is_12h_daytime_shift`; the shift is therefore returned as `covered_by_24h` instead of `covered_by_12h_day`. This conflates the explicitly independent 12H daytime bucket with 24H coverage (and similarly misclassifies broader partial windows such as 06:00–20:00).
